name: Truffle Bomb Live Resin All-in-One Device | 1g
description: Truffle Bomb is a strain featuring dominant terpenes—β-Myrcene, β-Caryophyllene, Limonene—delivering a bold, terpene-rich flavor profile. Crafted with proprietary zero heat solvent removal process, this formulation is 100% Live Resin. This All-in-One device is built for a smooth, full-bodied live resin experience: flavor-forward, satisfying, and consistent from the first pull to the last. Designed for real-life convenience, it’s pre-charged and ready to use, making it an easy go-to for elevated, on-the-go sessions. Enjoy Truffle Bomb with Dabstract’s Live Resin All-in-One Device.
